description: This file defines asynchronous work item classes used by the Orleans runtime scheduler to encapsulate tasks (closures) with associated context and execution logic.

classes.name: AsyncClosureWorkItem
classes.description: Represents an asynchronous work item encapsulating a Task-returning delegate, with support for completion tracking and grain context.

classes.name: AsyncClosureWorkItem<T>
classes.description: A generic asynchronous work item that encapsulates a Task-returning delegate with a result, supporting completion and contextual information.

classes.name: ClosureWorkItem<TState>
classes.description: Represents a work item that executes a synchronous closure with a state, supporting completion tracking and grain context.

methods.name: GetMethodName
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the delegate's target and method, used for naming.
